WORKERS_MODE.description: 运行策略：`free`（默认，免费版容量限制）或 `paid`（更高容量，需自行开通 Workers Paid）。此选项不会更改计费套餐。 / Capacity policy: `free` (default, Free limits) or `paid` (larger limits; enable Workers Paid separately). This does not change your billing plan.

DEFAULT_PASSWORD.description: 首次登录密码，用户名为 `user`。请使用独立强密码，升级时保留当前值。 / Initial login password for username `user`. Use a unique strong password and keep the existing value when updating.

AUTH_SECRET.description: 独立随机密钥：使用 `openssl rand -hex 32` 生成 64 个十六进制字符。升级或切换模式时保持不变，否则已保存的登录密码将失效。 / Independent random key: generate 64 hexadecimal characters with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it unchanged on updates and mode switches, or saved login passwords will stop working.

SHAREURL.description: 分享链接的路径前缀，默认 `subscription/`。必须非空，且不能占用 `/editor`。 / Share-link path prefix, default `subscription/`. Must be non-empty and outside `/editor`.

BASEURL.description: 分享链接的根地址。留空时自动使用当前请求来源；手动设置时请以 `/` 结尾。 / Base URL for share links. Leave empty to use the current request origin; include a trailing `/` when setting it manually.

DB.description: 保存订阅设置和密码校验值的 D1 数据库。绑定名保持为 `DB`；升级时继续使用同一数据库。 / D1 database for subscriptions and password verifiers. Keep the binding named `DB` and reuse the same database on updates.
